In this episode of Lallantop's Ghoom Gham series, Reporter Rajat Pandey and Video Journalist Yogesh Yadav travel to Amroha, Uttar Pradesh, to explore the history and tradition of dholak manufacturing.
Known for its distinctive dholak making industry, Amroha has a long association with the craft. Through this ground report, we meet local dholak manufacturers and artisans to understand how the instruments are made, the challenges they face, and how this traditional business has evolved over the years.
